title: A closer look at Jackalope.
description: A more expressive landing page brings the workspace and its parallel workflow into focus.
items: An oversized animated brand mark frames the actual app, with a quick path to the tour and waitlist.
Explore parallel tasks earlier, review the interface, and try palettes across the page.
note: Website development milestone, not a public app release.

title: Feedback after you have tried Jackalope
description: Share thoughts after reviewing real task results, with optional email follow-up and quiet in-app invitations.
items: Control invitations, snooze requests, and stop this feedback round after responding.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: A new look at Jackalope in motion.
description: Watch our 32-second launch film from the landing page or app tour.
items: See parallel agent work, the agent roster, and review in a light-theme animated preview with music and captions.
note: The preview uses sample project data. Join the waitlist for early access.

title: Expanded agent ecosystem and multi-agent routing.
description: Support for 8 coding agents, broad package manager discovery, multi-account tags, intelligent task routing, and interactive multi-agent decomposition.
items: Built-in detection across npm, pnpm, yarn, pipx, scoop, cargo, winget, and brew for Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Aider, and Goose.
Multi-account custom tagging, visual badges, and one-click import of default CLI logins.
Automatic best-fit task routing and interactive goal splitting into sequenced subtasks across specialized agents.
note: Prerelease milestone. Desktop builds pass all automated verification checks.

title: Your next hop into Jackalope.
description: Track your waitlist place, bring people along, and share Instant Access Passes once you are in.
items: Unlimited verified waitlist referrals earn priority, with progress visible to you and the admin.
Accepted members get five passes to bring people straight into early access.
Clear emails guide verification, referral milestones, pass claims, and expired reservations.
note: Development milestone. Service migration and real email acceptance are required before rollout.

title: A cross-platform workspace.
description: Jackalope's public copy and launch assets now describe a cross-platform workspace for coding agents.
items: The launch film, submission images, captions and outreach copy use a shared early-access invitation.
note: Development milestone, not a public release. The first launch is planned for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

title: A clearer path into Jackalope.
description: Explore the current workspace and help shape our first cross-platform launch.
items: Optional signup preferences and admin insights guide onboarding.
Find invitations, compare workflows, and watch the updated app tour.
note: Development milestone. Deployment and cross-platform installed acceptance remain pending.

title: Newsletter artwork stays behind the signup.
description: The folding Echo outline now remains behind the early-access form as it animates.
items: The signup surface keeps its text and controls clear in light and dark appearances.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: Follow Jackalope on X.
description: The website now makes Jackalope's official X profile easy to find from every page.
items: A Follow on X link is available in the shared footer.
note: Website milestone, not a public product release.

title: A clearer view of parallel work.
description: The website now shows how different kinds of agent work move through Jackalope instead of repeating one generic workflow diagram.
items: Three animated scenes distinguish feature delivery, regression tracing, and open-ended design exploration.
Route lines, layered studies, and evidence cards extend the visual language used in Jackalope campaign artwork.
The early-access form now uses the same line motif and a higher-contrast theme-colored action.
Focused discovery pages explain parallel agents, Git worktrees, supported adapters, project context, recurring work, and review.
note: Website milestone, not a public product release. Motion respects reduced-motion preferences.

title: More of the work, in one place.
description: The current development build brings task work and project context into a more focused workspace.
items: Tasks groups active work, saved evidence, and recurring work. Project holds codebase exploration, worktrees, and context.
Project tool selections can travel with Codex and Claude Code task launches, while existing CLI-global tools remain available.
Recurring work includes timezone and missed-run controls. The app must remain running; it cannot wake a closed app or a sleeping computer.
Account-aware usage views and locally bundled fonts are part of the current development build.
note: Development milestone, not a public release. Installed-app acceptance, signing, and the first public Windows installer remain pending.

title: A first look at Jackalope.
description: A place to explore the product and follow what comes next.
items: Real interface captures in light and dark appearances, using an explicitly fictional Atlas project.
An interactive recorded tour covering task drafting, patch review, agent selection, and the live theme palette.
A three-step introduction, product notes, and an early-access waitlist.
note: The walkthrough illustrates the interface with sample data. It does not launch an agent task.
